name: Actor
syntax:
[SelectionBase]
[DewResourceLink(ResourceLinkBy.Type)]
public class Actor : DewNetworkBehaviour, ILogicUpdate, ICleanup, ICustomDestroyRoutine

fields.name: children
fields.summary: Alive, non-destroyed children actors.

fields.name: childrenInNetwork
fields.summary: Children that are alive, or not yet despawned from the network.

fields.name: ClientActorEvent_OnCreate
fields.summary: Called everywhere when an actor is created including child actors.

fields.name: ClientActorEvent_OnDestroyed
fields.summary: Called everywhere when this actor is destroyed.

fields.name: dealtCooldownReductionByRatioProcessor
fields.summary: Processor for dealt cooldown reductions by ratio. This is only valid on server.All cooldown reductions done by this actor will be processed by this and every ancestor's preprocessors.

fields.name: dealtCooldownReductionProcessor
fields.summary: Processor for dealt cooldown reductions of fixed amount. This is only valid on server.All cooldown reductions done by this actor will be processed by this and every ancestor's preprocessors.

fields.name: dealtDamageProcessor
fields.summary: Processor for all dealt damages (Except pure damage). This is only valid on server.All damages from this actor will be processed by this and every ancestors' preprocessors.

fields.name: dealtHealProcessor
fields.summary: Processor for dealt heals. This is only valid on server.All heals from this actor will be processed by this and every ancestors' preprocessors.

fields.name: dealtManaHealProcessor
fields.summary: Processor for dealt mana heals. This is only valid on server.All mana heals from this actor will be processed by this and every ancestors' preprocessors.

fields.name: dealtShieldProcessor
fields.summary: Processor for received shields. This is only valid on server.

fields.name: persistentData
fields.summary: Available on server. Generic persistent data storage that will be saved and loaded with this actor.

fields.name: persistentSyncedData
fields.summary: Available everywhere, and can only be set on server. Generic persistent synced data storage that will be saved and loaded with this actor, and be synced across the network.Use this to store states in the network context. (think: synced variables)

properties.name: ancestors
properties.summary: Enumerable ancestors of this actor. Ordering is the same as the actor tree order, first element being the direct parent.

properties.name: chainTempName
properties.summary: Reaction chain of this actor. Available only on server.

properties.name: creationTime
properties.summary: Time of this actor's creation byTime.time.

properties.name: firstEntity
properties.summary: The first entity in this actor's ancestor tree.This property can be used to e.g. find the caster of an ability instance.

properties.name: firstTrigger
properties.summary: The first ability trigger in this actor's ancestor tree.This property can be used to e.g. find the ability instance's trigger.

properties.name: isDestroyLocked
properties.summary: Is someone preventing this actor from being destroyed? Available only on server.

properties.name: isNewInstance
properties.summary: Is it this actor created in this session of the game, or has been loaded from save?e.g. This will be false if this actor is part of a loaded game, or from previously visited node.

properties.name: persistentNetId
properties.summary: Mirror setsnetIdto 0 on despawn. This property will tell you its former netId even after being despawned.

properties.name: position
properties.summary: Position of this actor. Same astransform.position.

properties.name: rotation
properties.summary: Rotation of this actor. Same astransform.rotation.

methods.name: ActiveFrameUpdate()
methods.summary: Called everywhere every frame while this actor is active.

methods.name: ActiveLogicUpdate(float)
methods.summary: Called everywhere every logic tick while this actor is active.

methods.declaration: public void ApplyCooldownReductionByRatio(AbilityTrigger trigger, float ratio, bool ignoreCanReceiveCooldown = false)
methods.summary: Apply cooldown reduction to all configs that can receive cooldown reduction by ratio of max cooldown.

methods.summary: Clear flag that excludes this actor from room save.Note this won't make non-saving by default actors to be saved.

methods.declaration: public Se_GenericEffectContainer CreateBasicEffect(Entity victim, BasicEffect eff, float duration, string id = null, DuplicateEffectBehavior onDuplicate = DuplicateEffectBehavior.ReplacePrevious)
methods.summary: Create a generic container status effect for applying basic effect to an entity.Give an id of null to prevent this behavior.The created status effect will be cleansable and killed by unstoppable if it contains a harmful effect.

methods.summary: Create a new status effect and attach it to an entity.This can return null if the creation fails:e.g. Trying to apply a status effect with isKilledByUnstoppable flag to an unstoppable/invulnerable entity.

methods.name: CustomRpc_RegisterClientMessageHandler<T>(Action<T>)
methods.summary: Register a client RPC handler. (server to clients) Registering multiple handlers for same type will result in all handlers passed being called.

methods.name: CustomRpc_RegisterServerMessageHandler<T>(Action<T>)
methods.summary: Register a server RPC handler. (client to server) Registering multiple handlers for same type will result in all handlers passed being called.

methods.name: CustomRpc_RegisterServerMessageHandler<T>(string, Action<T, DewPlayer>)
methods.declaration: public void CustomRpc_RegisterServerMessageHandler<T>(string type, Action<T, DewPlayer> handler)
methods.summary: Register a server RPC handler. (client to server) Registering multiple handlers for same type will result in all handlers passed being called.This variant allows you to receive the caller client as a parameter.

methods.name: CustomRpc_SendMessageToAllClients<T>(T)
methods.summary: Make a remote procedure call: Server => All Clients

methods.name: CustomRpc_SendMessageToClient<T>(DewPlayer, T)
methods.summary: Make a remote procedure call: Server => Specific Client

methods.name: CustomRpc_SendMessageToServer<T>(T)
methods.summary: Make a remote procedure call: Client => ServerHosts can also make use of this RPC.

methods.name: DealDamage(DamageData, Entity, ReactionChain)
methods.declaration: public void DealDamage(DamageData damage, Entity target, ReactionChain chain = default)
methods.summary: Deal custom damage to the target entity.

methods.name: DefaultDamage(float, float)
methods.declaration: public DamageData DefaultDamage(float amount, float procCoefficient = 1)

methods.name: Destroy()
methods.summary: Destroy this actor.It will do its own cleanups on server and then despawn.This is irreversible.

methods.name: DoBasicAttackHit(Entity, bool, bool, float, float)
methods.declaration: public void DoBasicAttackHit(Entity target, bool isCriticalHit, bool isMain, float damage, float attackEffect)
methods.summary: Make the parent entity do basic attack and deal damage to the target entity.By design this should be only used by basic attacks.This triggers Attack Effects if the hit was successful.

methods.name: DoHeal(HealData, Entity, ReactionChain)
methods.declaration: public void DoHeal(HealData heal, Entity target, ReactionChain chain = default)
methods.summary: Heal an entity by some amount.

methods.name: DoManaHeal(HealData, Entity, ReactionChain)
methods.declaration: public void DoManaHeal(HealData heal, Entity target, ReactionChain chain = default)
methods.summary: Grant an entity some mana.

methods.name: ExcludeFromRoomSave()
methods.summary: Mark this actor as excluded from room save.

methods.declaration: public T FindFirstOfType<T>() where T : Actor
methods.summary: Find first actor that matches the given type in this actor's ancestor tree including itself.

methods.name: GetOriginalName()
methods.summary: Get the original name of this actor, excluding (Clone) or variant suffixes.Useful when trying to figure out id of name-linked resources.

methods.name: GiveShield(Entity, float, float, bool, ReactionChain)

methods.name: IsDescendantOf(Actor)
methods.summary: Is this actor a descendant of the given actor?Is the given actor this actor's ancestor (parent/grand-parent/grand-grand-parent...)?

methods.name: IsDescendantOf<T>()
methods.declaration: public bool IsDescendantOf<T>() where T : Actor
methods.summary: Is this actor a descendant of the given actor?Is the given actor this actor's ancestor (parent/grand-parent/grand-grand-parent...)?

methods.name: IsExcludedFromRoomSave()
methods.summary: Is this actor marked as excluded from room saves?

methods.name: LockDestroy()
methods.summary: Prevent this actor from being destroyed. You MUST call UnlockDestroy() after LockDestroy() call.

methods.name: MagicDamage(float, float)
methods.declaration: public DamageData MagicDamage(float amount, float procCoefficient = 1)

methods.name: OnCreate()
methods.summary: Called everywhere when this actor is created.

methods.name: OnDestroyActor()
methods.summary:
Called everywhere when this actor is being destroyed.
This is different from similarly-named Unity event OnDestroy, as it is called before GameObject itself gets destroyed.

methods.name: OnPrepare()
methods.summary:
Called on server right before actor is spawned.
Configure this actor's initial state here.

methods.name: RefundMana(float, Entity)
methods.declaration: public void RefundMana(float amount, Entity target)
methods.summary: Refund a certain amount of mana to an entity.This will not be processed, will not proc any callbacks nor display a mana heal number text.This shouldn't be used anywhere other than for canceled channels.

methods.name: ResetCooldown(AbilityTrigger, bool)

methods.name: ShouldBeSavedWithRoom()
methods.summary: Should this actor be saved and loaded back in when revisiting nodes?This is checked on server on all active actors when changing rooms.

methods.summary: Show an on-screen timer with custom fill amount to local player.Null rawText will be automatically populated.
